entities.summary: Khairul Hafiz bin Jantan is a Malaysian sprinter, competing in events ranging from 100 metres to 400 metres. He was the former Malaysian 100 metres outdoor record holder with a time of 10.18 seconds. Khaiful Hafiz, representing home state Malacca, had broken the record set by Watson Nyambek during the Malaysia Games in Kuching in 2016. His personal best of 20.90 seconds in the 200 metres was the Malaysian national junior record.
